basis: User confirmed the previously agreed review parameters; not measured sensor calibration or training authorization.
formula: sigma(r)=sqrt(0.06^2+(0*r)^2); Gaussian error along the beam after return selection
terrain_bound_meaning: standard deviation, not an absolute height limit
seed_scope: scene ID and user seed, unchanged by weather category or time
world_background: exact detected surface XYZ shared with lidar view, including range error and uncompensated angular reconstruction
world_particles: physical transport illustrations, not sensor observations; no radial measurement error added to these particle positions
exceptions: Sun phantom ranges keep their dedicated timing-range model
Weak-signal mode uses its own signal-dependent range error without an extra 60mm layer
Edge mixing keeps its pulse-mixing model
